# vyos.blueprints.ipsec_route_based

Route-based site-to-site IPsec over VTI, with OSPF or BGP (Cisco, Palo Alto and Azure docs blueprints)

- Configures one IKE group, one ESP group, a pre-shared key and a site-to-site peer bound to a VTI per peer, with `disable-route-autoinstall` as route-based VPNs need. Optionally runs OSPF over the VTIs and adds a default route towards the WAN gateway.
- Uses vyos.vyos resource modules only (vyos_vpn_ipsec, vyos_vpn_ipsec_s2s, vyos_interfaces, vyos_l3_interfaces, vyos_ospfv2, vyos_ospf_interfaces, vyos_static_routes).
- The far end can be any IKE peer (Cisco, Palo Alto, another VyOS, a cloud gateway); match its proposals in the IKE/ESP group inputs.
- WAN and LAN addressing belongs to `vyos.blueprints.base`.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.ipsec_route_based
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ipsec_route_based_peers` | list | yes |  | Remote peers, one VTI each. |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.name` | str | yes |  | Peer name, e.g. `CISCO`. |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.local_address` | str | yes |  | Local WAN address used for IKE. |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.remote_address` | str | yes |  | Peer's WAN address. |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.local_id` | str |  |  | Local IKE id. Defaults to `local_address`. |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.remote_id` | str |  |  | Remote IKE id. Defaults to `remote_address`. |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.psk` | str | yes |  | Pre-shared key. |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.psk_type` | str |  |  | Encoding of `psk`. Not set when omitted (VyOS default, plaintext). |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.psk_name` | str |  |  | Name of the PSK entry. Defaults to `<name>-PSK`. Peers with the same `psk_name` share one entry carrying all their ids (they must use the same `psk`). |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.connection_type` | str |  | `initiate` | `initiate` brings the tunnel up from this side (recommended by the page when the far end only initiates on traffic); `none` only responds. |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.description` | str |  |  | Peer description. |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.ikev2_reauth` | str |  |  | Peer-level IKEv2 re-authentication. |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.esp_group_on_vti` | bool |  | `false` | Bind the ESP group on the VTI (`vti esp-group`) instead of `default-esp-group`, as Azure and GCP pages do. |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.vti` | dict | yes |  | Tunnel interface for this peer. |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.vti.interface` | str | yes |  | VTI name, e.g. `vti1`. |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.vti.address` | str | yes |  | Tunnel address in CIDR notation. |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.vti.mtu` | int |  |  | VTI MTU, e.g. `1438`. |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.vti.description` | str |  |  | VTI description. |
| `ipsec_route_based_peers.vti.adjust_mss` | str |  |  | TCP MSS clamping, e.g. `1350` (configured with vyos_config; vyos_interfaces has no option for it). |
| `ipsec_route_based_ike_group` | dict |  |  | IKE (phase 1) settings shared by all peers. Settings without a default here are configured only when given. |
| `ipsec_route_based_ike_group.name` | str |  | `IKE-GROUP` | Group name. |
| `ipsec_route_based_ike_group.proposal_id` | int |  | `10` | Proposal number. |
| `ipsec_route_based_ike_group.key_exchange` | str |  | `ikev2` | IKE version. |
| `ipsec_route_based_ike_group.ikev2_reauth` | bool |  | `false` | Re-authenticate on IKEv2 rekey. |
| `ipsec_route_based_ike_group.lifetime` | int |  |  | Lifetime in seconds. |
| `ipsec_route_based_ike_group.dh_group` | int |  | `14` | Diffie-Hellman group. |
| `ipsec_route_based_ike_group.encryption` | str |  | `aes256` | Encryption, e.g. `aes128`. |
| `ipsec_route_based_ike_group.hash` | str |  | `sha256` | Hash, e.g. `sha1`. |
| `ipsec_route_based_ike_group.prf` | str |  |  | PRF, e.g. `prfsha256` (set with vyos_config; vyos_vpn_ipsec does not render it). |
| `ipsec_route_based_ike_group.close_action` | str |  |  | Action when the peer closes the SA. |

| `ipsec_route_based_esp_group` | dict |  |  | ESP (phase 2) settings shared by all peers. Settings without a default here are configured only when given. |

| `ipsec_route_based_esp_group.mode` | str |  |  | ESP mode. |
| `ipsec_route_based_esp_group.lifetime` | int |  |  | Lifetime in seconds. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks the IPsec SA of every peer is up and, with OSPF, a Full adjacency on every VTI or, with BGP, every session established.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ipsec_route_based_peers` | list | yes |  | Same value as for `main`. |
| `ipsec_route_based_ospf` | dict |  |  | Same value as for `main`. |
| `ipsec_route_based_bgp` | dict |  |  | Same value as for `main`. |
